section: Въведение. Видове сходимости на случайни величини / п.с.
result: Definitions and claims valid; Borel--Cantelli application is sound using countable thresholds; no finding.

section: Въведение. Видове сходимости на случайни величини / по вероятност
result: Correct inclusions and quantifiers; no finding.

section: Въведение. Видове сходимости на случайни величини / по разпределение
result: Correct for real-valued random variables; no finding.
Implications and normal counterexample valid; typewriter endpoint assertion has finding L10-M-001.

section: Връзка между видовете сходимост / proofs and constant converse
result: All inclusions, limits, and strict-CDF endpoint handling are valid; no finding.
Markov/Chebyshev derivations valid; findings L10-M-002 and L10-M-003 cover omitted finite-moment and zero-variance conditions.
The iid-integrable statements are correct and the variance computation is correct; proof does not establish the stated full integrable WLLN, finding L10-M-004.
Computations and conditional conclusions are correct under iid sampling; independence/common-law hypotheses are unstated, finding L10-M-005.
Exercises 1--3 are valid. Exercise 4 shares the zero-variance proof edge case in L10-M-003.
